# SourceChip

Ties an AI claim to where it came from: a clause, a page, a URL.

Numbered so a reader can match a claim (a superscript in the answer) to its source. Opens or scrolls to the source. Show sources by default on any answer that states a fact; this is how people learn how far to trust the agent.
